purpose: 按钮布局审阅，等待用户选择后制作素材并接入

variants.name: 铜线横排
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Create a polished production-oriented proposal sheet for the Chinese Cthulhu card game 《邪神的宝藏》, using image 1 as the exact game-layout edit target and image 2 ONLY as the art-direction reference.
Image 1 is the earlier approved 1280x720 battle screen. Preserve the full scene, existing panel arrangement, cave background, player HP/SAN rows, log, every existing card and its exact original portrait shape. Every actual card stays width:height = 392:590; never stretch, widen, narrow, re-illustrate or reformat cards. Modify ONLY the local-player action controls within the bottom hand area. Do not redesign the rest of the game. The 4 player-hand cards remain at their original positions and original sizes.
Art direction from image 2: near-black ink-green surfaces, fine worn antique-brass linework, delicate incised corners, restrained occult ornament, pale parchment Chinese Songti serif labels, subtle desaturated jade accent. Elegant, spare, eerie, appropriate to this already dark UI. Legibility comes from clear ivory text, precise frame edges, spacing and local contrast, not saturated glowing fills.
Reject the recently disliked style: NO shiny gold blocks, NO green capsules, NO pill-shaped controls, NO glossy beveled mobile-game plastic, NO bubbly round icon badges, NO bright colored LED/neon, NO huge extruded frames, NO excessive tentacles. Labels must be clear Chinese: "掉包", "休息", "结束回合". Skill and rest are equally prominent main turn actions; end turn is secondary and visually separated. Use a small incised star for skill, quiet crescent or simple resting symbol for rest; no emoji-like icon.
Presentation canvas: approximately 1920x1440, landscape editorial game-UI design board. At top a very small proposal identifier in quiet typography; most of the sheet is a COMPLETE 16:9 view of the edited game screen (not cropped). At bottom, separated by a hairline, show a LARGE crisp close-up of precisely the SAME action-control design, around 2x, on its dark background, with the title "操作区细节". The close-up must match the full screen, not an alternative design. Do not add unrelated diagrams or asset sheets. No perspective mockup or device frame.
The screenshot must remain a faithful layout, legible enough to compare buttons against hand cards. This is a visual choice sheet, NOT a game asset sprite sheet.
VARIANT A — "A · 铜线横排". Keep action controls in the ORIGINAL upper-right of the bottom hand panel, immediately above the cards, with a generous quiet gap after the hand-count label on the left. Three controls in one horizontal row. Skill "掉包" and rest "休息" each approximately 125x42 logical pixels at the 1280x720 game scale. Both use the same flat near-black rectangular face with very small stepped corners, fine antique brass double-line edge borrowed directly from the main-menu "踏入黑暗" button; very sparse inward corner notches and tiny star/crescent line icons at the left. Their labels are about 17px logical, centered. A subtle desaturated jade inner edge may identify available actions, but both share the same dark material. End turn stays at the far right at about 94x34, with thin subdued edge, separated by 18px. Composition: neat restrained horizontal order, retaining the previous version's understated feel while visibly improving button clarity. Do not put buttons beside hand count on the left. Do not change the bottom hand area height.
